rewrite_disposition.rule: Apply only a high-confidence definition-accurate correction whose complete disagreeing-translation-unit set is within the proposal's rewrite cap.
rewrite_disposition.reason: The owned definitions make both readings high confidence, but fresh measurement places each complete definition-accurate rewrite set above the configured cap. Editing only the old minority sets would replace definition-accurate declarations with unprototyped or void-pointer declarations, so no game source was changed.
